subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Poonam usually sits / in a first row in the / weekend conference / hall every week.

options.text: in a first row in the

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"in a first row in the."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the part **"in a first row in the."**
